propositions: auto-deploy container restarts mid-review interrupt in-flight reviews and cast fail-closed LLM-Review -1 votes that block backfill reconciler recovery
DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS=45 is too short for measured review durations (260-911s) causing premature drain timeout and worker cancellation
coverage-gap decisions with retryable conditions (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled) must defer as NO-VOTE instead of fail-closed -1 to remain eligible for backfill re-drive
retryable vote-less deferrals must be tracked in a review_attempts ledger and escalate to fail-closed -1 with voter_error metric after N consecutive attempts per (change_id, revision)

terminal outcomes (finding, indeterminate) and teardown-mid-review must be discriminated: teardown via CancelledError during drain is retryable no-vote; genuine indeterminate conclusion is fail-closed -1
vote-less changes must remain unsubmittable and post nothing to Gerrit so backfill reconciler's no-vote pre-filter applies without suppression
